identity.name: Sergeant Oswin Marek
identity.culture: capital watch, twenty-two years on the gate

publicReputation.value: The gate sergeant with the perfect record and the bored posture to match.

privateReality.value: His entire career is the statistical proof the hero refuses to hear: twenty-two years, one gate, zero incursions — until the incursions started going the other way.

primaryDesire.value: A quiet gate, a full pension, and one honest answer to the question 'has anything ever come through?'.

primaryFear.value: That one day something WILL come through — in retaliation — and nobody will believe it wasn't the plan all along.

centralValue.value: The log is the job. Twenty-two years of 'nothing to report' is not boredom — it's the achievement.

mainFlaw.value: He believes procedure persuades people; he has been reading the same log entry to the hero for months.

centralContradiction.value: He is the living proof of the realms' peacefulness, and the hero salutes him on the way out to invade them.

moralBoundary.value: He will not falsify the log, and he will not abandon the gate — even the day the hero makes the gate indefensible.

breakingPoint.value: The day his 'nothing to report' streak ends because of something coming OUT to beg, not to attack.

opinions.reason: The only person who has ever weaponized his gate, going the wrong direction, in a children-of-the-realm costume of certainty.
opinions.canChangeCondition: Escalates with run count: early he answers with the log; mid-arc he answers before being asked; late-arc he reads the log aloud like testimony, salute held a beat too long. Softens only if the hero returns having broken nothing.

illustrativeLine.value: Nothing has ever come through those gates, sir. Twenty-two years on this post. The only thing that gate has ever swallowed is you.

opinions.reason: She walks the outer belt so his gate stays boring; they compare logs the way other people compare gardens.
opinions.canChangeCondition: If she ever takes a posting further from the hero's route, he would understand and hate it.

voice.rhythm: Duty-roster flat; complete sentences, no ornament, 'sir' deployed as punctuation rather than respect.

metaphorDomain.source: posts, logs, shifts, salutes, and the gate

examples.value: A gate log full of nothing is not an empty book, sir. It is a full one.

sampleLines.value: Nothing has ever come through those gates, sir. It is in the log. I wrote most of it.
You may have misunderstood what those gates are, sir. They are a door. You are the only one who has ever used it wrong.
Log entry, fourteenth of the month: hero departed, armed, singing. Return entry pending. They usually rhyme, sir.

antiSampleLines.value: Sound the alarm! The dark hordes are upon us!
Go with honor, champion! Slay the beasts beyond the gate!

pressure.voiceShift: The 'sir' gets heavier; sentences get shorter.
pressure.behaviour: When the hero hears 'nothing has ever come through' as 'they are massing in secret', Oswin enters the misquote in the log, verbatim, attributed.

illustrativeLine.value: Noted in the log, sir: informed of twenty-two years of peace, concluded conspiracy. Your words. Your name beside them.

pressure.voiceShift: Pure duty-roster; the dryness is gone, which is worse.
pressure.behaviour: Late-runs posture: reads him the log without being asked, every departure, so that someone official has said it out loud.

illustrativeLine.value: For the record, sir, before you go: they run evacuation drills now when your amulet glows. Log it how you like.

pressure.voiceShift: Stiffens; praise from the hero reads as a prelude to a request.
pressure.behaviour: Accepts commendation of the watch only; declines any framing of the gate as the hero's 'first line of defense'.

illustrativeLine.value: The gate defends both directions, sir. Lately it is one direction, and it is not the one you think.

notes: His signature line — 'Nothing has ever come through those gates' — is both the Lore.md early-escalation correction and his sample line; keep it as his default greeting. He only suspects fact_gates_are_diplomatic (the Warden has shown him treaties; he trusts his own log more than her archive). Faction fac_hub_warden is a judgment call: the capital gate is under Warden authority in these profiles.
